candidates.title: File:Beautiful purple flowers by the lakeside (35777103294).jpg
candidates.description: Beautiful purple flowers by the lakeside- you can hardly spot them as the contrast between dark purple and dark green is very low indeed! This is one of the more 'natural' looking parts of the park, there was nothing else built up around here barring the boardwalk we are on. We are now in the Xixi Wetlands Reserve in Hangzhou, China and are heading towards the exit. Detailed notes about the reserve appear in previous captions, earlier in this album.  (Hangzhou, China, May 2017)

candidates.title: File:Another shot of the humped pedestrian bridge (36474584631).jpg
candidates.description: Another shot of the humped (arched) pedestrian bridge in the distance in the Xixi wetlands reserve. This one is made of stone, unlike many wooden ones we encountered as well. Another picture of this bridge along with some notes appeared earlier in this album. The bridge appears to be closed as there is a barrier running across it's width at the highest point of the arch. We are now in the Xixi Wetlands Reserve and detailed notes about the reserve appear in previous captions, earlier in this album.  (Hangzhou, China, May 2017)

candidates.title: File:Another humped bridge, in a delightfully shady setting (36474600321).jpg
candidates.description: Another humped (arched) bridge, this one in a delightfully shady setting. This seems to be a more recent addition as the hump is angled, giving the bridge a trapezoidal shape.  Traditional Chinese humped (arched) bridges are exactly that- a curved arch. We are now in the Xixi Wetlands Reserve in Hangzhou, China and detailed notes about the reserve appear in previous captions, earlier in this album.  (Hangzhou, China, May 2017)

candidates.title: File:Lovely canna flowers growing by the lakeside (36474417841).jpg
candidates.description: Lovely canna flowers growing by the lakeside in the Xixi Wetlands Reserve. The park was so large that it was impossible to keep track of each and every one of the things we saw, but with this row of canna plants, my guess there is a park or garden behind it. We are now on a boat in the Xixi Wetlands Reserve in Hangzhou, China and are heading towards the exit. Detailed notes about the reserve appear in previous captions, earlier in this album.  (Hangzhou, China, May 2017)

candidates.title: File:Beautiful water lilies on the Xixi Wetland Park (36443482612).jpg
candidates.description: And these are the water lilies the two girls in the previous picture were shooting. After walking past them, I noticed a place on the way where the flowers were much close to the boardwalk. So at this spot, I was able to do what those girls did- get off the boardwalk and zoom in a bit at the beautiful fresh blooms. We are now in the Xixi Wetlands Reserve in Hangzhou, China and are heading towards the exit. Detailed notes about the reserve appear in previous captions, earlier in this album.  (Hangzhou, China, May 2017)
